styles.name: A 學術手繪
styles.style: Fine dark-navy pen outlines and light translucent watercolor washes on the objects only. Lively human sketchbook linework, warm restrained editorial illustration, slightly storybook academic field-guide mood. Flat-to-gently-dimensional, sparse texture, charming but mature. No leather/gold ornamental realism.
styles.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a transparent comparison sheet of three illustrated navigation icons for an academic website with a subtle playful gaming mood.
Layout: horizontal triptych, exactly three equal-sized isolated object groups in ONE evenly spaced row, on a wide roughly 3:1 canvas. Left = an open course notebook with a small triangle-and-three-nodes sketch on its page. Center = one research paper with a small connected-node drawing and a magnifying glass leaning across it. Right = an inviting university stone arch doorway with two small abstract person-shaped tokens at its base. Same visual weight and consistent view across all three. Each silhouette fully inside its own third, generous clear separation, nothing overlaps the neighboring icon. Readable at about 80–120px per icon.
Palette: academic midnight navy, warm ivory, restrained brass gold, a touch of muted teal. No text, labels, numbers, lettering, logos, UI, borders, background panels or watermark. No weapons, magic or fantasy creatures. True transparent alpha background, no checkerboard, no colored backdrop, no glow or surrounding haze. Crisp clean cutout edges with only subtle local contact shadows.
Style/medium: Fine dark-navy pen outlines and light translucent watercolor washes on the objects only. Lively human sketchbook linework, warm restrained editorial illustration, slightly storybook academic field-guide mood. Flat-to-gently-dimensional, sparse texture, charming but mature. No leather/gold ornamental realism.

styles.name: B 柔和 3D
styles.style: Premium softly rounded 3D clay miniatures, matte ceramic and soft-touch materials, smooth rounded geometry, gentle isometric perspective, inviting tactile toy-like proportions. Carefully modeled simple surfaces and soft studio illumination. Elegant and academic, not photorealistic, no painterly texture.
